g.text: Drag the anatomical terms below into their corresponding dotted slots on the diagram.
Drag tiles from the word bank.
Drop them into the matching box.

text.tspan: Pollination occurs when tiny pollen grains are
moved from the male anther to the female stigma,
often carried by helpful insects like bees.

g.text: Here are a few clues to help you:
The Pistil is the female part. It includes the Stigma, Style, and Ovary.
The Stamen is the male part. It includes the Filament and Anther.
The Sepal protects the bud before it opens (the green leaves at base).

text.tspan: Because this is a static learning module, we cannot
automatically grade your placements. Check a textbook or
use the hint to verify you placed them correctly.
In a fully interactive environment, this would instantly
snap all labels back to the word bank. You can mentally
start fresh and review the connections!
